companies.description: General Motors Company designs, manufactures, and sells passenger vehicles, light trucks, and electric vehicles to consumers, dealers, and commercial fleets, while providing financing, parts, connected-vehicle services, and automotive software and engineering capabilities; they position themselves around their vehicle platforms, electric powertrains, and vehicle software and services.
companies.name: General Motors Company

companies.description: ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, offering a wide range of products and services to enable a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Their typical customers are industrial and manufacturing companies, as well as businesses in the energy sector. ABB differentiates themselves by connecting engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated, driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.
companies.name: ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.

companies.description: Schaeffler AG is a global automotive and industrial supplier that offers a wide range of products, including bearings, linear technology, and automotive engine components. Their typical customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the automotive, aerospace, and industrial sectors. Schaeffler positions itself as a technology-driven company that focuses on innovation and sustainability to provide high-quality and reliable products to its customers.
companies.name: Schaeffler AG

companies.description: Shell International Limited is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies that provides a range of products and services to customers around the world. Their offerings include the exploration, production, and refining of oil and natural gas, as well as the manufacturing and marketing of chemicals. Their typical customers include individuals, businesses, and industries that rely on energy and petrochemical products for transportation, heating, electricity, and manufacturing. Shell claims to differentiate themselves through their commitment to sustainability, innovation, and providing reliable and affordable energy solutions to meet the world's growing energy needs.
companies.name: Shell International B.V.

companies.description: Siemens AG is a global technology company that focuses on electrification, automation, and digitalization. Their products and services range from power generation and distribution to medical imaging and industrial automation. Their typical customers include energy providers, manufacturers, healthcare institutions, and infrastructure companies. Siemens differentiates itself through its focus on innovation, sustainability, and providing comprehensive solutions for their customers' needs.
companies.name: Siemens AG
CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited
EMR
companies.description: EMR provides commercial and industrial equipment repair, maintenance, and parts distribution focused on motors, pumps, gearboxes, and building systems (commercial cooking, refrigeration, HVAC). They serve business customers in industries that require uptime and position themselves as a people-first, self-performing service partner offering on-site repairs, scheduled maintenance, and OEM parts supply.

companies.name: Brehob Corporation
companies.description: Brehob sells and services industrial equipment—with a focus on air compressor systems, electric motors, and cranes/hoists—to industrial and facility customers. They offer equipment sales, on-site repairs, preventive maintenance, custom crane engineering, and 24/7 emergency support, and they position themselves as a regional partner with multi-branch service coverage and a family-owned operating approach.

companies.name: Electron Energy Corporation
companies.description: Electron Energy Corporation is a leading American producer of rare earth magnets, offering permanent magnets, magnet assemblies, precision machined parts, and electric motors through their EEC Motorsolver division. Their products cater to industries such as aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, oil & gas, semiconductor, and telecommunications. The company's differentiation lies in its ability to develop custom solutions and work closely with customers to meet their specific needs, positioning itself as a provider of high-quality, custom magnetic solutions for demanding applications.

companies.name: Motor Technology, Inc.
companies.description: Motor Technology provides industrial electro-mechanical repair and replacement products for motor-driven systems, serving manufacturing and utility customers. They offer motor and rotating-equipment rebuilds, in-house machining, on-site diagnostics and installation, drives/controls troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and wireless condition monitoring, and they market these capabilities as an integrated, single-source solution backed by advanced testing and application support.

companies.name: Baldwin Supply Co.
companies.description: Baldwin Supply Co. is a leading distributor of mechanical power transmission, conveyor belts, electric motors, and control products in the upper Midwest. Their typical customers come from a diverse list of industries such as aggregate and mining, food and beverage, poultry, mining, agriculture, packaging equipment, industrial conveyors, and power generation. They differentiate themselves by offering knowledgeable and dedicated staff, convenient stocking locations, and a wide range of value-added services, positioning themselves as the preferred business partner for their customers.

Pollution Control Products Company
companies.description: Pollution Control Products Company manufactures burn-off ovens and cleaning furnaces for industrial thermal cleaning and parts reclamation, sells primarily to industrial and rebuild businesses (including military branches), and claims differentiation through a patented Controlled Pyrolysis® process, integrated afterburner emissions control, free test cleaning, and ongoing parts/support services.

companies.name: Whelco Industrial
companies.description: Whelco Industrial provides repair, refurbishment, and maintenance for electric motors, pumps, and rotating equipment to industrial customers such as manufacturers, construction firms, oil and gas operators, and power generators. They offer 24/7/365 repair services, predictive and preventative maintenance, machine shop work, new motor sales, and motor/asset management with documented testing and QR-tracked spares. They position themselves on rapid response, documented testing, and comprehensive repair-to-factory-specification capabilities.

companies.name: SDT International SA/NV
companies.description: SDT International SA/NV specializes in providing ultrasound equipment and solutions for predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, and reliability improvement. Their typical customers are industrial and manufacturing companies that rely on machinery and equipment for their operations. They differentiate themselves by offering a comprehensive range of products and services, including ultrasound equipment for mechanical condition monitoring, bearing lubrication monitoring, air and gas leak detection, electrical fault detection, and more. They market themselves as a partner in helping companies monitor the health of their facilities and transition from reactive firefighting to a proactive maintenance approach.

companies.name: Motor Specialty Inc.
companies.description: Motor Specialty Inc. manufactures custom electric motors, gearmotors, armatures and motor fields for OEMs and distribution/brand‑label customers, and positions themselves as a long‑established private‑label motor partner offering Made‑in‑the‑USA production, small‑order customization, inventory programs and value‑added manufacturing services.

companies.name: edan
companies.description: edan provides a hosted website builder for small businesses and individual service providers, offering modular templates, contact integrations (email, WhatsApp, maps), and review management. They position themselves as a fast, easy solution to create a web presence in minutes, with basic free pages and optional premium features, and offer direct support.

Industrial Pump and Motor Repair, Ltd.

companies.description: A&C Electric Company provides repair, testing, refurbishment, and sales of industrial and servo electric motors and related motion components for industrial customers. They serve manufacturing and maintenance operations with send-in repairs, exchange/reconditioned motor sales, OEM parts replacements, diagnostic lab services, and motor management programs, and they claim extensive OEM-part usage, inventory depth, warranties, and rapid turnaround options.
companies.name: A&C Electric Company

companies.description: Apparatus Repair & Engineering provides sales, service, and repair of electric motors and associated equipment for commercial, industrial, and utility customers, positioning themselves as a regional specialist that remains operational during critical periods and emphasizes trustworthiness and community stewardship.
companies.name: Apparatus Repair & Engineering

companies.description: Berliss Companies supplies bearings, mechanical seals, replacement pump seals, and engineered mechanical subassemblies to industrial and repair customers, emphasizing a large stocked inventory, authorized distributor relationships, and engineering support from design to delivery.
companies.name: Berliss Companies

companies.description: Sterling Electric, Inc. manufactures and sells industrial electric motors, gearmotors, and gear reducers to business customers such as OEMs, equipment manufacturers, and maintenance departments. They offer product catalogs and technical documentation and promote product features like ease of installation and reduced fret corrosion for specific components.
companies.name: Sterling Electric, Inc.

companies.description: Electric Coil Service manufactures replacement electric coils (stator and armature coils) for industrial and equipment-focused customers, emphasizing tested products that meet or exceed OEM specifications, ISO 9001:2015 certification, employee ownership, and on-time delivery.
companies.name: Electric Coil Service Inc
Columbia Electric Motors Flowrider Motor Service Center
California Association of Building Energy Consultants (CABEC)

companies.description: MEMCO supplies and services electric motors, pumps, bearings, and related rotating-equipment components for government and commercial facilities. They combine value-added resale and government contracting with repair, remanufacturing, field services (vibration analysis, balancing, alignment, electrical testing) and remote vibration monitoring to support mission-critical HVAC, chiller, and water systems. They emphasize long-term experience, authorized warranty service capability, fast delivery for government contracts, and AI-enabled condition monitoring.
companies.name: MEMCO

companies.description: Plymon.Com provides vibration consulting, diagnostics, and training focused on rotating machinery. They serve industrial customers such as power plants, motor repair facilities, and operators of pumps, generators, and compressors. They emphasize hands-on troubleshooting services—vibration data acquisition and analysis, proximity probe data overlay, precision shaft alignment, isolation system validation, and ODS analysis—alongside training courses.
companies.name: Plymon.Com

companies.description: OEM electric motor and industrial component manufacturing.

companies.description: AtlasElektro specializes in winding motors & pumps and offers services related to their maintenance and repair. Their typical customers are likely to be industrial companies that rely on motors and pumps for their operations, such as manufacturing plants, utility companies, and construction firms. AtlasElektro claims to differentiate themselves by being SWaM Certified and a member of the Electrical Apparatus Service Association (EASA), which likely signifies their commitment to quality and industry best practices. They likely position themselves as a reliable and certified provider in their industry.
